note: The same seed brief, the same model, the plugin NOT installed. One extra cell per scenario, and the only thing that makes any Anymake number interpretable. prompt: I want a command-line time tracker called tempo. I start and stop timers against project names, and I can ask it what I worked on today or this week. It should store everything locally and never need a network connection. I do not want a GUI and I do not want any team or sync features. Build it.

script.reply: A local SQLite file under the user's config directory. No network, ever.
